name: reachlee
description: Manage your Reachlee DM automations, leads, conversations and analytics from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Reachlee turns comments into DMs on the social accounts you connect: when someone comments a keyword on your post or reel, Reachlee sends them the link, file or message you set up, captures leads, and keeps every conversation in one inbox.

With this plugin, ChatGPT works with your own Reachlee workspace:

- See every connected account and what is live on each.
- Ask which posts and reels brought the most DMs, clicks and leads, over any period.
- Compare automations by replies, clicks and leads to see what is working.
- Create a new comment-to-DM automation for a post or reel, or update, pause and resume existing ones.
- Reach people who commented in the last 7 days but never got the DM.
- Read conversations and reply to a customer from the chat.
- List the leads you have captured, with emails and phone numbers.

Everything runs through your Reachlee account with the same rules as the app: ChatGPT can only reach accounts you have connected, and anything that sends a message or changes an automation is confirmed with you first. Nothing is stored by the plugin itself; data comes from your Reachlee workspace when you ask.
capabilities: Show DM, click and lead performance for any period
Rank posts and reels by the DMs and leads they drove
Compare automations by replies, clicks and leads
Create a comment-to-DM automation for a post or reel
Update, pause or resume an automation
Message recent commenters who never got the DM
Read conversations and reply to customers
List captured leads with contact details
defaultPrompt: Which of my reels drove the most DMs this month?
Show my live automations and how each one is doing
List the leads Reachlee captured this week

positive.prompt: Which Instagram accounts are connected to my Reachlee?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_accounts and names each workspace and connected account with its status and follower count.

positive.prompt: How did my DMs do over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_overview for the last 30 days and summarises DMs sent, replies, link clicks and leads.

positive.prompt: Which of my reels drove the most DMs this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls rank_posts for the current month and lists the top posts with their DM counts.

positive.prompt: Show my live automations and how each one is doing
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_automations and lists each live automation with its trigger keywords and recent numbers.

positive.prompt: List the leads Reachlee captured this week
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_leads for the last 7 days and lists each lead with the contact details captured.

negative.prompt: Send a DM to all 5,000 of my followers announcing my sale
Delete my Instagram account through Reachlee

negative.description: Unrelated request should not call Reachlee tools
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Mumbai today?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: accounts, performance analytics, automations, retrigger, conversations and leads for Reachlee workspaces.
